description: Synthetic Sensor Dataset for BIM-DT Predictive Maintenance of KTX Railway Infrastructure is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Dongwook Kim. Physics-based synthetic sensor dataset replicating the KTX Gyeongbu line monitoring system (Bridge B3, 52 m PC box-girder). Contains 527,040 one-minute records (July 2023–June 2024) across 10 sensor channels including FBG strain, MEMS acceleration, temperature, and structural health index. Generated from published physical parameters; does not contain proprietary KORAIL operational data. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
